newsitem.title: CHINA: China Shijiazhuang airport opens to foreign planes.
newsitem.headline: China Shijiazhuang airport opens to foreign planes.

text.p: Shijiazhuang city in north China's Hebei province has opened its airport to foreign aircraft, the People's Daily Overseas Edition said on Tuesday.
The State Council, or cabinet, had recently decided to make the airport a back-up landing area for international flights, the newspaper said.
The airport would also be made into a flight training base, it said but gave no further details.
Shijiazhuang is the capital of Hebei province and is about 200 kilometres (124 miles) southwest of Beijing.
